text: Effective time management matters a lot in today's fast-paced work environment. People who build good organizational habits are better placed to meet deadlines and keep stress down. A few strategies can help people get more done. First, prioritize. If you figure out the most important tasks and do them first, the critical stuff gets done. Second, cut down on distractions, which plays a big role. Setting aside dedicated blocks of time for focused work is widely seen as helpful. Finally, regular breaks are important for keeping performance up.
